subject: Eval readout + owners rally: Kepler POC success criteria & weekly actions
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@keplerai.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@keplerai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC success criteria

Thanks again for your time earlier — good discussion. Quick recap and a proposed minimal set of success criteria so we can lock the POC plan: 

Summary of ask: Kepler wants a proof that Redwood reduces latency for shorter queries while preserving extraction fidelity for named-entity outputs across your 3 core workflows (ingest -> extraction -> rerank).

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 350ms for average 120-token sessions.
- Accuracy: entity extraction F1 >= 0.87 against your labeled dev set (v1).
- Cost: token cost per inference reduced by >= 30% vs your current hosted endpoint with batching/kv-cache enabled.
- Stability: no critical errors in 7 days of continuous test traffic.

Suggested timeline:
- Kickoff: Mon July 19 (week of) — 2 week active ramp, 2 week evaluation window.
- Internal owners: Redwood: Mark (technical lead), Ben (model tuning), Marissa (customer success/ops). Kepler: Samira (product), Liam (SRE).

Next steps (actionable):
1) Kepler: confirm success criteria and provide sample labeled dev set + a secure S3 read role by Wed July 14.
2) Redwood: share POC roadmap + security checklist (attached).
3) Schedule 30m kickoff for July 19 — propose 16:00 PT.

Attachments: Kepler_POC_Roadmap_v1.pdf (draft), Redwood_Security_Checklist_v1.pdf (attached separately).

If the criteria above look off, flag changes inline and we will update. Looking to lock this by Wed so we can reserve Dedicated slots for the run.

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira@keplerai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@keplerai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC success criteria

Thanks Mark — that summary is great and mostly aligns with internal expectations. A couple clarifications from our side:

- F1 target: we can commit to running against our labeled v1 set; the team would be comfortable with F1 >= 0.85 as a start, with a stretch goal of 0.88 once Ben performs tuning. Can we include both baseline and tuned numbers in the report?
- Latency: 350ms 95p sounds reasonable, though our queries skew shorter (~50 tokens) — we can provide a short/long traffic split.
- Security: we'll need the SOC2 evidence and a short network diagram for the VPC option before we start ingesting any data. I'll share the asset list by Wed.

Action items from Kepler:
- Share labeled dev set (S3) + test traffic profile by Wed 14 July (Samira).
- Provide security contact for SOC2 pack (Liam).

We'll take the July 19 kickoff; 16:00 PT works for the core team.

Samira
Samira Khan
Director of Product, Kepler AI
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@keplerai.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@keplerai.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC success criteria

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmation. Notes / commitments from our side: 

- We'll include both baseline (no tuning) and tuned results in the final readout and show token-cost delta with the same traffic shape you provide.
- Security: attaching Kepler_POC_Roadmap_v1.pdf and our Security QA template (Kepler_Security_QA.xlsx). Monica (CS) will handle compliance artifacts and follow up on SOC2 packaging.
- Owners / immediate tasks:
  - Ben: allocate two Dedicated GPUs and prepare tuning pipeline + test harness (owner: ben_carter).
  - Marissa: run onboarding calls and coordinate test accounts (owner: marissa_cole).
  - Markus: finalize roll plan and monitor metrics during the run (owner: markus_klein).

Confirming kickoff: Mon Jul 19, 16:00 PT — I’ll send calendar invite with agenda.

Deliverables before kickoff (by Wed Jul 14):
- Kepler: S3 access + labeled dev set (Samira).
- Redwood: final POC roadmap + presigned test endpoints for smoke test (Markus / Ben).

If anyone needs to swap ownership for a task, call it out and we’ll reassign.

Thanks — marking this as locked unless we hear changes by EOD Wed.

-Markus
